public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Eon Systems is a private AI & Software company founded by Michael Andregg at an undisclosed stage. The relevant peer universe comprises 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI—a total of 9 data points across the AI & Software sector.

The peer-median method could not be applied due to insufficient data density within appropriately narrow peer cohorts. Of the 16 same-sector peers identified, none satisfied the filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables. A minimum of 3 datapoints per filter is required to establish reliable median benchmarks; relying on all-sector medians without stage or tier alignment would introduce unacceptable noise and reduce analytical rigor.

Without successful triangulation across standard valuation methodologies, no quantitative range is supported by the available data. The analysis indicates that Eon Systems occupies a sparsely-mapped position within its sector—too early, too specialized, or too differentiated to anchor cleanly against existing public or private comps. Key uncertainties center on revenue scale, unit economics, and capital intensity relative to the broader AI & Software universe. Further diligence would require access to Eon's financial metrics, stage documentation, and granular peer financials before a defensible valuation range can be established.
